import json
import pathlib
import sys

limit = json.loads(pathlib.Path("lint.json").read_text())["max_line"]
bad = [f"{p}:{n}" for p in pathlib.Path("src").rglob("*.py")
       for n, line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(), 1) if len(line) > limit]
print("\n".join(bad) or "lint clean")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
